title: 美联储理事库克：按兵不动也是行动，再等下去会落后多少？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: In my view, financial conditions are too accommodated at a time when inflation remains stubbornly above target with no clear signs of disinflation and train.
segments.zh: 在我看来，金融环境过于宽松，而通胀仍顽固高于目标，且没有明确的去通胀迹象。

segments.en: The current stance of policy does not appear to be curtailing the AI buildout and equity prices contribute to support consumer spending.
segments.zh: 当前政策立场似乎并未抑制人工智能建设，权益价格也在支撑消费支出。

segments.en: As a result, holding our policy rate steady will lead to a positive and widening output gap and increasing inflationary pressure.
segments.zh: 因此，保持政策利率不变将导致产出缺口扩大且为正，并增加通胀压力。

segments.en: Indeed, we are seeing elevated inflation in a broad swath of goods and services.
segments.zh: 事实上，我们看到大量商品和服务的通胀处于高位。

segments.en: I see the act of holding the rate steady as much a monetary policy action as the act of increasing the rate.
segments.zh: 我认为，保持利率不变与加息一样，都是货币政策行动。

segments.en: Second, my vote reflected the urgency I feel to tackle inflation.
segments.zh: 其次，我的投票反映了我对解决通胀问题的紧迫感。

segments.en: Inflation has been above target for more than five and a half years and every additional day poses greater risk that price and wage setters will address their inflation expectations upward.
segments.zh: 通胀已高于目标超过五年半，每多一天，价格和工资制定者上调通胀预期的风险就更大。

segments.en: Furthermore, waiting longer to implement rate increases, risk getting behind the curve.
segments.zh: 此外，等待更长时间才加息，有可能落后于曲线。

segments.en: If we fall behind additional and larger rate increases may be required to catch up later, which could increase stress on our financial system and have unnecessarily damaging effects on American households.
segments.zh: 如果我们落后，之后可能需要额外且更大幅度的加息来追赶，这可能会增加金融系统的压力，并对美国家庭产生不必要的损害。
